narrative.overview: The page is a blueprint of one lot. Propietas indigo is the ground of the whole tour; white and sky-blue linework, hatching, a dotted route and a walking dot describe the lot, the house and the pool, while a scroll-linked camera moves from the lot to each room. Real photographs are the only warm colour and sit on the blue as outlined plates. Below the tour the ground turns to a blue-tinted paper with indigo ink.
keyCharacteristics: Indigo ground for the tour and closing band; blue-tinted paper (#edf2fa) for facts, map and agency.
Linework in white and sky; no warm colour except photographs.
Heavy geometric sans headings (800) over regular-weight text, tabular numerals.
Flat, square-cornered (2px), no shadows except one on the floating action button.
The plan SVG uses px-space labels scaled by a JS camera so type stays legible at any zoom.

rules.name: The Brand Blue Only Rule
rules.body: Hues are indigo and sky; any new tint is derived from them. Warmth comes from photographs alone.

rules.name: The Ground Switch Rule
rules.body: Indigo is the ground while the plan is being walked; paper is the ground once the visitor is reading facts. Do not mix grounds inside a section.

rules.name: The Halo Label Rule
rules.body: Text drawn on the plan carries an indigo stroke halo so it reads over linework.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat; separation is by outline, ruled line or ground change.

dos: Do use only #2e3192 and #29aae2 as hues, with white, sky-soft and deep indigo as supports.
Do keep headings at weight 800 with negative tracking, body at 400, numerals tabular.
Do keep the 2px corner and flat surfaces; frame with 1 to 1.5px outlines.
Do keep the illustrative-drawing disclosure visible in the stage and the footer.
Do label drawn text in px space with an indigo halo.
Do swap the focus ring to indigo on paper and footer grounds.
Do keep WhatsApp one tap away (hero, closing band, FAB).
donts: Don't introduce warm colour outside photographs.
Don't use rounded cards, icon-card amenity grids, or a hero photo; the plan is the hero.
Don't add shadows to surfaces other than the floating button.
Don't present the drawing's positions or scale as measured.
Don't publish the seller's name, on the page or in the repo. The agent's matrícula (N° 117, COCICH) is published, user-approved.
Don't claim Gotham; Montserrat is a stand-in until a web license is confirmed.
